verdicts.reason: Both break the product badge: the cream circle has come loose and sits clipped in the bottom-left corner, and the can is left as a faint outline with no fill, so the key image and brand mark are lost. A is also worse in layout: the can is tiny and floats high, the headline nearly touches the Try It button, and there is a big gap between the headline and 'Out now.'. B gives the can more size, wraps the headline into a tidy two-line block with its subline close beneath it, and leaves sensible space before the CTA.
